findings.title: Cleanup exceptions can bypass retained failure checkpoint
findings.problem: finally can raise in terminate_owned, stream/log closure/sanitization, approved-source rehash or final guard; checkpoint.json is written only afterward. This can skip subsequent cleanup and the retained failure result. Confirmed actual exception path, not an assertion that cleanup has failed in a real run.
findings.minimal_fix: Independent bounded cleanup try/finally blocks, record sanitized cleanup/guard failure, passed=false, independently close stream, and attempt private checkpoint persistence from outermost finally. Never count an attempted/unconfirmed reap as success.

findings.title: Expected authored subject is not fully joined to outcome/report
findings.problem: One COMPLETE job plus matching row.run_id/owner_run_id does not check expected submission_id/policy_id, actual author strategy content hash, outcome.run_id, or feedback.run_id. Actual automatic input-to-report provenance claim is under-asserted.
findings.minimal_fix: Read exact submission/policy/input/implementation fields for the single expected job; require outcome.run_id==owner_run_id==feedback.run_id, expected authored strategy_content_hash and actual intake manifest_hash. Preserve normal actual records; no writes or result overrides.

findings.title: Owned native process status and exact stop identity are recorded but not asserted
findings.problem: product-status response is merely retained; final result does not require exact roles control/research, and stop-product receipt is not matched to observed coordinator token. Claim of the single coordinator owning the required actual services needs these assertions.
findings.minimal_fix: Require actual coordinator/control/research RECENT_HEARTBEAT, expected subject/config, actual owns_pid membership, runtime NOT_STARTED. Match stop receipt process_generation_id to coordinator token. Require exact final role set and each STOPPED/exit0/forced_stopfalse/tree_reapedtrue.

findings.title: Stored aggregate outbox artifact commitment is not verified
findings.problem: validate_feedback_publication validates actual feedback/report bytes and logical path, and feedback_hash is checked. row.artifact_hash is retained but never compared to the actual aggregate payload closure.
findings.minimal_fix: Compute SHA256 of canonical {payload_name:SHA256(payload_bytes)} and compare row.artifact_hash before export and after repeated observation.
